import sys

k = 10**9 + 7

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    v = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    b = [0] * (1 << n)
    for i in range(1 << n):
        pc = bin(i).count("1")
        b[i] = len(v[pc])
        v[pc].append(i)

    dp = [{} for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp[0][1] = 1

    for i in range(n):
        p = [0] * n
        for j in range(n):
            p[j] = int(next(it))
            p[j] = (p[j] * 570000004) % k

        for mask_val, val in dp[i].items():
            a = [0] * n
            for m in v[i]:
                if (mask_val >> b[m]) & 1:
                    for j in range(n):
                        if (m >> j) & 1 == 0:
                            a[j] |= 1 << b[m | (1 << j)]

            for m in range(1 << n):
                X = 1
                M = 0
                for j in range(n):
                    if (m >> j) & 1:
                        M |= a[j]
                        X = (X * p[j]) % k
                    else:
                        X = (X * (1 - p[j] + k)) % k
                dp[i + 1][M] = (dp[i + 1].get(M, 0) + val * X) % k

    sys.stdout.write(str(dp[n][1]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
